# uv.lock

**What it is:** generated by uv, about 1,360 lines. It records the exact version and hash of every package installed, including dependencies of dependencies, so every machine and CI get identical installs (`uv sync --locked`). pip-audit checks these exact versions.

**Don't edit it by hand.** `uv add`, `uv remove` and `uv lock --upgrade` update it. Commit it whenever it changes.
